name: Closed City
source:
Children with special abilities were called the “risk child”. These children were brought to a closed city under heavy control of the government. Riko came to live in this city at a very young age. She’s kept to herself all her life because of her abilities, but that would soon change however...

[from [url=https://www.instagram.com/p/BwGQqswpXK9/]Instagram[/url]]
translation:
拥有特殊能力的孩子被称为“危险儿童”。他们被送往一座由政府严密管控的封闭都市。Riko很小的时候就来到这里生活。由于自身的能力，她一直独来独往，但这一切很快就会改变…

[摘自[url=https://www.instagram.com/p/BwGQqswpXK9/]Instagram[/url]]
